controls.name: children
controls.description: Markdown source, rendered as HTML that never carries scripts, styles, event handlers or unsafe URLs.

controls.name: gfm
controls.description: GitHub Flavored Markdown as in GitHub comments: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, a line break as a break; `false` parses plain CommonMark.

controls.name: html
controls.description: Render raw HTML in the source through an allowlist of text and block tags (no scripts, styles, forms, frames or attributes that run code); otherwise it shows as typed.

controls.name: linkTarget
controls.description: Where links to other sites (http(s) and protocol-relative URLs) open; relative links, anchors and mailto/tel links always open in place.

controls.name: linkRel
controls.description: `rel` of every link to another site, whatever its target, such as `nofollow ugc noopener` for user content; an empty string adds none.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Wrap the block in the 1px outer spacing box that Face UI controls share, to line it up with controls in a row.
